program='''from collections import deque
from math import log

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==grid[0][0] or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=set()
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); cells.add((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append((color,cells))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for color,cells in comps:
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs); mh,mw=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
        if mh<4 or mw<3 or len(cells)!=mh+mw-1: continue
        elbow=None
        for er,ec in ((r0,c0),(r0,c1),(r1,c0),(r1,c1)):
            if cells==({(er,x) for x in range(c0,c1+1)}|{(y,ec) for y in range(r0,r1+1)}): elbow=(er,ec); break
        if elbow is None: continue
        er,ec=elbow; up=er==r1; left=ec==c1
        candidates=[]
        for oc,other in comps:
            if other is cells or oc==color or len(other)<3: continue
            rr=[r for r,c in other]; cc=[c for r,c in other]
            th,tw=max(rr)-min(rr)+1,max(cc)-min(cc)+1
            if (mh>=mw and th<tw) or (mw>mh and tw<th): continue
            cy=sum(rr)/len(rr); cx=sum(cc)/len(cc)
            dr=(cy-er)*(1 if up else -1); dc=(cx-ec)*(1 if left else -1)
            direction_penalty=0 if dr>=0 and dc>=0 else 1.5
            score=abs(log(th/(mh*.6)))+abs(log(tw/(mw*.6)))+direction_penalty
            score+=.01*(abs(cy-er)+abs(cx-ec))
            candidates.append((score,min(rr),min(cc),other))
        if candidates:
            target=min(candidates,key=lambda z:(z[0],z[1],z[2]))[3]
            for r,c in target: out[r][c]=color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(program)
exec(compile(program,str(p),'exec'),globals())
out=transform(grid)
print([(r,c,grid[r][c],out[r][c]) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c]!=out[r][c]])
